about: Text that only looks like something the engine reads stays text (ADR-0047): a trailing line break, or digits other than ASCII's, make no date, time, Reference or table name. Found while porting the engine to TypeScript, whose patterns end at the end and read ASCII digits only.

cases.name: ADR-0047: a date typed with a line break after it stays text
ADR-0047: a time typed with a line break after it stays text
ADR-0047: a month name date typed with a line break after it stays text
ADR-0047: a date or a time in Arabic-Indic digits stays text
ADR-0047: INDIRECT's R1C1 text with a line break after it is no Reference
ADR-0047: a table name with a line break after it is refused
ADR-0047: a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane sorts in its own class, an emoji among the symbols and 𠮷 among the letters
